s.note: the first night hanging out with Austin
s.how: Arrange 200g cheddar, 150g brie, 150g salami, 200g crackers, 150g olives and pickles on a large board. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.n: Back at Austin's chips and dip
s.note: hanging out back at Austin's place
s.how: Slowly cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter for 25 minutes until deep golden, cool and chop. Mix with 250g sour cream, salt and pepper. Serve with 200g thick-cut potato chips.

m.note: the attempt at a proper dinner party
m.how: Season 4 rump steaks and grill 4 minutes a side. Roast 1kg potatoes in oil at 210C for 40 minutes. Serve with salad leaves dressed with oil and lemon.

w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, add 220g sugar until glossy and spoon 8 clouds onto a tray. Bake at 120C for 1 hour and cool in the oven. Serve with 300ml whipped cream and berries.

d.note: trying to keep up with the cool neighbour
d.how: Chill 8 bottles of pale ale and serve in pint glasses. Lemon squash for anyone not drinking. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
